summary: America's Car-Mart filed an 8-K announcing an extension of a limited waiver under its Credit Agreement from September 7 to September 11, 2026, deferring potential defaults tied to missed financial covenants. The company concurrently disclosed ongoing strategic alternative evaluation, including potential financing, recapitalization, or restructuring, with active discussions among third parties, the Agent (Silver Point Finance), and lenders. No transaction terms or valuation are provided. Monitoring focus centers on whether the company secures a permanent waiver or announces a restructuring or other deal before the extended deadline.
